newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 10.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
President Jiang Zemin warns leaders not to allow recent bumper harvests to make them complacent on agricultural work.
Northwestern Heilongjiang province harvests record 30 million tonnes of grain in 1996.
Central bank closes one of China's largest investment trust houses because of irregularities and other serious problems.
State Statistical Bureau economist says tight monetary policy should be continued because inflationary pressures still strong.
President Jiang Zemin tells visiting officials of Siemens AG he hopes German giant will strengthen cooperation with China on technology transfer and product development.
Central bank chief Dai Xianglong says Chinese financial institutions will not be granted special privileges in Hong Kong after British colony returns to Chinese rule in July.
China's tax authorities to tighten controls on foreign-funded firms.
Central bank chief Dai Xianglong tells national conference China will continue its moderately tight monetary policy and will this year keep inflation below 1996 levels.
